verses.text: The grave of the Jews was found in Syria, between the two rivers, beginning from Iabok and extending to the gates of Jerusalem; it is a book that speaks of how they were destroyed in their ruins, lest the holy city be laid waste.

From Samaria to the gates of Jerusalem, and throughout all its districts, it has been laid waste, and except for a few, they were slain by the sword. The Edomites and the Syrians, along with the Amalekites, have become one with the Moabite man in the destruction of the city of Jerusalem.
The children of Israel, in their time of distress, raised up the Moabite grave; and he slew them all with the sword.
Therefore, the enemies of the Lord were emboldened against the holy city; and they were confirmed in their wickedness.
The Edomites and the Elophites dwelt there; because they had transgressed the word of the Lord, He has turned against them, and they began to destroy the city of the Lord.
And that grave of the Moabites is a remnant of their nation; and they rose up with strength and joined themselves with those who were with them.

To destroy the city of the Lord, they dwelt in the ravines of Mesopotamia-Gelabuh, as far as Syria; and there they joined with the Elophites and the Amalekites, to commit wickedness together, and they gave them much gold and silver, horses and chariots.
In unity they came and devoured the lamb; and those who dwelt within it shed blood like water.

And they made Jerusalem like a watchman of a garden; and within it they raised a voice; and the Lord did all the works of wickedness that He does not love; they forsook the city of the Lord, which is filled with righteousness and holiness.
"They prepared the flesh of your sons for the birds of the heavens as food. And the flesh of your righteous for the beasts of the earth they made as a meal."

And they took their wives and the son of the dead; for they had done so, not fearing God, as Satan had instructed them. Therefore, the Lord God, who searches the heart and the mind, until He becomes angry, caused them to bring forth the seed that was in the womb of the women who were pregnant.
And the people of God rejoiced over the evil that they had done, and they returned to their land; and they took the spoil of that which they had plundered from the holy city.
And when they returned to their house, they made merry, and they sang and danced with joy.
The prophet who is called "the seer" said, "In due time, may your light shine today; for the Holy One of Israel, the Lord God, shall not forsake you in your sanctuary."
The horses are swift; therefore, shall I not say, "I will run"?
I too shall follow you; for the people shall rise against you from the Amorites; do not be dismayed by the destruction and the wrath of God that shall come upon you, I tell you.

I shall wear the armor of iron; shall I not say that I cannot withstand the battle and the sword? The Holy One of Israel, the Lord God, shall not forsake you in the battle; however, a strong disease of the heart that divides from the battle and from the sword, I shall bring upon you.

I have lifted my wrath against you; I shall bring upon you the disease of the heart; and he who helps you shall be cast down; your name shall be blotted out from the earth until you are destroyed from my hand.

I have made your neck stiff and raised your head high above my city; this matter, as I hastened like an eagle when I did it, you shall know that I am your Creator, the Lord God; you are as chaff before the wind, as fire consumes it; and the fierce wind shall sweep you away from the earth as it blows, thus you are before me.
I have lifted my wrath against you; I do not know your Creator, and I shall declare all that belongs to you; I shall not withhold from you all that is upon your head.

Now return from all the evil you have done; if you return and stand before God, and if you lament and weep, and if with a pure heart you call upon Him, the Lord shall forgive all your sins that you have committed.
At that time, the grave shall be a dwelling place for the wicked because of their sins before the Lord. The Lord has been provoked.

And the Lord, through the words of His prophet, has declared that He will not forsake the sanctuary. Their eyes are opened and they shall not sleep; their ears are opened and they shall not be deaf; the word that has been spoken shall not be false, for in a moment, like an eagle, it shall come to pass.

And he tore his garments, and he put on sackcloth; and he bowed down upon his head, for he was greatly distressed concerning the work he had done, and he cried out before the Creator, before the Lord, and he was greatly troubled.
The remnant of Moab is near to Syria, and the prophet spoke concerning it.
And the sword entered into his neck; he was afflicted with bitter lamentation; for before God, because of his work, his sin entered into his heart.

And the Lord said unto His prophet, “Return from the land of Judah to Ramath and to Moab, and to the graves. And the Lord saith thus: ‘Do not say that I will destroy the city of My holiness by the strength of My might and by My army; for I, the Lord, have sent you with My command, but this thing you have done is not of you.’”
In all her distress, in her anguish and in her sorrow, she is indeed grievous.

And I, in my distress, have delivered her into your hand; because of your affliction, I have strengthened the city in my hand, and because of you, it is not so. Now, concerning her children, may the Lord forgive your iniquity.
Now, with a pure heart, enter into repentance. Those who are called to repentance do not hesitate, and do not be one who hesitates.
But those who enter into repentance with a pure heart, concerning their transgressions, in every place they enter, they are indeed righteous, and they shall not return to sin and iniquity.

In lamentation and in sorrow, in much prayer and in supplication, they who return to their Creator and to the Lord are indeed righteous; for those who have entered into repentance after your transgression, you are My people, saith He.

The arrogant shall return to Him in repentance, and in the time of their return, because of your fear and because of your iniquity, I will forgive you; for I am the Lord, who brings the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation, but for those who love Me and keep My commandments, I will show mercy unto a thousand generations.

Now, concerning your children, I will keep the covenant that is with you; and concerning the iniquity that you have committed, I will accept your repentance, saith the Holy One of Israel, who is able to do all things.

And it came to pass that he went forth from the pit, and he said, "I have grieved the Lord my God, and I have done as you desired; but may the Lord do thus and thus to me, lest I be forsaken by you. For there is no law for us, and I will not walk in the commandment as our fathers did; and you know that we worship idols as our fathers taught us."

"I have erred in my sin and in my pride, and I am a sinner who has grieved my Creator; for until now I have not heard the word of the Lord my God’s prophets; and when I was commanded, I did not obey His law and His commandment."
And the prophet returned and said, "There is no sin that has been faithful from among you and your kindred; therefore, I know that today you have received forgiveness."

"From now on, cast away the idols; let your return be genuine, and turn to know the Lord your God." And he bowed down before the prophet, and the prophet arose; and he commanded all that was right and good.
And the Lord did as He commanded, and he returned to his house.
And he established his mind; and he cast away the idols from his house, and the ancient ones, and those who worship idols, and the sorcerers, and he expelled the diviners.

And those who were brought from Jerusalem, their fathers did as the Lord commanded, and they did all His commandments, and they kept His ordinances and His law, as it was said, and they were examined day and night.
And the children of those who were instructed were in the house of their teachers.

And the children of Israel were taught the law of the Lord, and they entered into the sanctuary; and the teachers who kept the little ones were from among the elders; and they heard all the ordinances and the law, and their prayers and their judgments, and all the ordinances that the Moabites did were heard from the children brought from Jerusalem.

Their altars, their ancient ones, and their idols, day and night, from among the people, from the high places and from the good places, for the idols that were offered to them, the offerings and the wine were consumed.
በቀትርና በሰዓት በሥራው ሁሉ ይሰግድላቸውና ያመልካቸው ነበር፤ ይለምናቸውና ይተማመናቸውም ነበር፤ እንዲሁም ከመንገዱ በተመለሰ ጊዜ ይለምናቸው ነበር፤ የጣዖታቱ ካህናትም በነገሩት ሁሉ ፈቃዳቸውን ያደርግ ነበር።
በነገሩ ሁሉ የሚያድኑት ይመስለው ነበርና የነገሩትን ሁሉ አይንቅም ነበር።
ያ መቃቢስ ግን የእነርሱን መንገድ ተወ።
ነቢይ የሚሉት የረኣዩን ነገር ከሰማ በኋላም በንስሓ መንገዱን አሣመረ፤ በዚያም ወራት ወገኖቹ ሁሉ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ይልቅ መንገዳቸውን አሣመሩ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች አንድ ጊዜ ያሳዝኑት ነበርና በቀሠፋቸውም ጊዜ ዐውቀው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጮኹ ነበርና።
መከራ በሚያጸኑባቸው በአሕዛብ እጅ ተይዘው እንደ ተዋረዱ፥ ወደ እርሱም እንደ ጮሁ በሰማ ጊዜ የአባቶቻቸውን መሐላ አስቦ የዚያን ጊዜ ስለ አባቶቻቸው ስለ አብርሃምና ስለ ይስሐቅ፥ ስለ ያዕቆብም ይቅር ይላቸው ነበር።
በአዳናቸውም ጊዜ ያዳናቸውን ይረሱት ነበር፤ ጣዖታቱንም ወደ ማምለክ ይመለሱ ነበር።
ያንጊዜም በመከራ የሚያሠቃዩአቸው አሕዛብን ያስነሣባቸው ነበር፤ በአሠቃዩአቸውና ባሳዘኑአቸውም ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጮሁ ነበር፤ የዚያን ጊዜም ራርቶ ይቅር ይላቸው ነበር። የእጁ ፍጥረት ስለ ሆኑ ይወድዳቸው ነበርና።
ዳግመኛም በሚጠብቃቸው ጊዜ በዙሪያቸው ያለ ጣዖትን በማምለክና በክፉው የእጃቸው ሥራ ያሳዝኑት ዘንድ ይመለሱ ነበር።
እርሱ ግን የኢሎፍሊንና የሞዓብን፥ የምድያምንና የሶርያን፥ የግብፅንም ሕዝብ ያስነሣባቸው ነበር፤ ጠላቶቻቸውም ድል በነሷቸው ጊዜ፥ መከራ በአጸኑባቸውና በአስገበሯቸው ጊዜ፥ በገዟቸውም ጊዜ ይጮሁና ያለቅሱ ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔርም በወደደበት ጊዜ ያድኗቸው ዘንድ መሳፍንትን ያስነሣላቸው ነበር፤ መሳፍንቱም ያድኗቸው ነበር።
በኢያሱም እነርሱን ያዳነበት ጊዜ አለ።
በጌዴዎን እነርሱን ያዳነበት ጊዜ አለ።
በሶምሶን፥ በባርቅና በዲቦራ፥ በዮዲትም እነርሱን ያዳነበት ጊዜ አለ፤ በሴትም ቢሆን፥ በወንድም ቢሆን አድሮ ከሚያሠቃዩአቸው ጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ያድኗቸው ዘንድ መሳፍንትን ያስነሣላቸው ነበር።
እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ወደደ ከሚያሠቃዩአቸው ሰዎች እጅ ያድናቸው ነበር።
በአደረገላቸውም በጎ ነገር ሁሉ በምድራቸው ዘር፥ በምድረ በዳ ያለ መንጋቸውን ሁሉና ከብታቸውንም በማብዛት ደስ ይላቸው ነበር።
ከብታቸውንና ተክላቸውን ይባርክላቸው ነበር፤ በቤትና በምድረ በዳ የያዙትንም ሁሉ ይባርክላቸው ነበር፤ በዐይነ ምሕረት ይመለከታቸው ነበርና እንስሶቻቸውን አያሳንስባቸውም ነበር፤ የጻድቃን ልጆች ናቸውና ፈጽሞ ይወዳቸው ነበር።
እነርሱ ግን በሥራቸው ክፉ በሆኑ ጊዜ በጠላቶቻቸው እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣቸው ነበር።
በሚያጠፋቸውም ጊዜ ወዲያውኑ ይሹት ነበር፤ ተመልሰውም ወደ ፈጣሪያቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይገሠግሡ ነበር።
በፍጹም ልቡናቸውም በተመለሱ ጊዜ ኀጢአታቸውን ያስተሰርይላቸው ነበር፤ ሥጋና ደም እንደ ሆኑ ያውቃቸዋልና የሚያስት የዚህ ዓለም አሳብና፥ አጋንንትም አሉባቸውና የቀደመ ኀጢአታቸውን አያስብባቸውም ነበር።
ያ መቃቢስ ግን እግዚአብሔር በቅዱሱ ተራራ የሠራውን ይህን ሥርዐት በሰማ ጊዜ በንስሓ ተጋደለ።

This matter was not hidden from us, for after seeing and hearing, we did not cease to do good works; for the Lord God had mercy upon them, and the children of Israel did not cease to perform all the kindnesses they were to do; and when His commandments were being proclaimed, the Lord would not forsake them in the time of their distress, and they would cry out; and He would again say, "Forgive them," and they would keep His law.
The one who was a leader would likewise direct his path; he would also keep the commandment; for in Israel, the God of Israel, he would be faithful to the commandment.
At that time, the children of Israel would be gathered together, and after hearing from heaven, they would keep the commandments of the Lord, and they would be as one.
His household and his children would walk in all the law and commandments of the Lord, and they would be diligent in their service.
The Jew would keep the statutes that were given to him; he would also hear and keep the commandment; he was of a distinct Moabite lineage, and the Jew would keep the food that was forbidden to him.

He would bring forth the tithes; from the best and the least, from the firstborn of the cattle and all that belonged to him, he would give; likewise, the Jew would bring his offerings and return to Jerusalem to offer.
He would offer the offerings for his sins and transgressions, for his vows and peace offerings, and the offerings of the seasons.

He would also give the first of the harvest; the Jew would offer the wine offerings and give to the priest and the Levite; the Jew would do all that was commanded, and he would also give his firstfruits.

The offerings of the firstfruits and the cakes, the tables and the altars, the four kinds of grain and the garments, for the holy ones, the lights of pure oil, when they served the Lord, Israel would prepare the sanctuary as they were to do for the holy ones.

In the time when they were in the law and the statutes, the Lord also, with compassion, would not forsake them in the hand of their enemies; the leader would, like them, do good works in all his ways.
መሪ እንዲሆነው፥ ከመረጣቸውና ፈቃዱን ከአደረጉ ከእስራኤል ወገኖችም እንዳይለየው ሁልጊዜ ወደ እስራኤል ፈጣሪ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጸልይ ነበር።
በጽዮን ልጅን፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ቤትን ይሰጠው ዘንድ፥ በነቢዩ አንደበት ከተናገረው ከጥፋትም ያድነው ዘንድ ንስሓ በገባበትና በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በአለቀሰው ልቅሶ ሁሉ ንስሓውን ይቀበለው ዘንድ፥
ዘሩንም ከምድር እንዳያጠፋበት፥ በመግባቱና በመውጣቱም ይጠብቀው ዘንድ ዳግመኛ ይጸልይ ነበር።
በመቃቢስ ሥልጣን በታች ከአሉ ከሞዓብ አሕዛብም ያምኑ ዘንድ ደስ አላቸው፤ አለቃቸው በቀናች መንገድ ይሄድ ነበርና፥ ፍርዱንም ይመለከቱ ነበር፤ ፈቃዱንም ያደርጉ ነበር፤ የአገራቸውን ፍርድና ያገራቸውን ቋንቋ ይንቁ ነበርና የመቃቢስም ሥራ እንደሚቀናና እንደሚሻል ያስተውሉ ነበር።
ወደ እርሱም መጥተው የመቃቢስን የቸርነቱንና የእውነቱን ፍርድ ይሰሙ ነበር።
ብዙ ገንዘብም ነበረው፤ ወንዶች ባሮችና ሴቶች ባሮች፥ ግመሎችና አህዮችም ነበሩት፤ ጥሩር የሚለብሱ አምስት መቶ ፈረሶችም ነበሩት፤ ኢሎፍላውያንንና አማሌቃውያንን፥ ሶርያውያንንም ፈጽሞ ድል ይነሣቸው ነበር፤ ቀድሞ ጣዖት ሲያመልክ ግን ድል ሲነሡት ኖረ።
እግዚአብሔርን ከአመነ ወዲህ ግን ወደ ሰልፍ ሲሄድ እርሱ ድል ይነሣ ነበር እንጂ እርሱን ድል የነሣው አልነበረም።
እነርሱ ግን ይወጉት ዘንድ በጣዖቶቻቸው ኀይል ይመጡ ነበር፤ በጣዖቶቻቸውም ስም ጠርተው ይረግሙት ነበር፤ ነገር ግን እምነቱን በፈጣሪው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ አድርጓልና ድል የሚነሣው አልነበረም።
እንዲህም እያደረገና ጠላቶቹንም ድል እየነሣ፥ አሕዛብንም በሥልጣኑ እየገዛ ኖረ።
ስለ ተበደሉትም ይበቀል ነበር፤ የድሃአደጉንም ፍርድ ያጸድቅ ነበር፤
He used to receive the widows and the poor in their time of trouble; he would provide for those who were hungry with food; and for those who were naked, he would cover them with clothing.

He delighted in wisdom and in the work of his hands; he would give without hesitation from what he possessed; and for the house of the sanctuary, he would give tenfold; while he was performing his duties, he did so with a good heart.

And he also was a father who cared for his children; and their father did all that was right for them; he kept the order of his house; and he watched over all his kin; he did not allow the poor and the widows, nor the children of the dead to be oppressed.

They feared God; they would lend their money to the poor; their father would keep all that was entrusted to them; they would take care of their widows and the children of the dead in their time of trouble; they would be as a father and a mother to them; they would extend their hand to those who were in need, and they would protect them from all harm and sorrow.
Thus they lived for five years.
After this, the king of the Canaanites, Zirrucida, came; he destroyed all their land; he killed the children of the slain; he devastated all their dwellings.

He took all their wealth; and they were not judged by the command and decree of God, but rather they were led by all wickedness and sin, by idolatry and abominations, and they carried with them the gods of their idols back to their land.
They devoured the dead and their blood, the flesh of the slain and the devoured, and God would not accept any of them; they had no law, being written in the origin, from the true command.
God brought them forth from their mother's womb and brought them in due time; their Creator and their Savior was not known to them.

In the time of judgment, they had no law; they would take their bread and their mothers and lead them to evil and to wickedness, and to sin and to death they would go. They would do all that is evil; they would take their sisters and their mothers; they had no law.
Their way was all darkness and gloom; it was wickedness and death.

Yet the children of the slain would keep all their order; they would not eat that which was slain nor that which was smitten; they would not commit all the wickedness and sin of the Canaanites. In this book, it is not written of the wicked and the transgressors, of the hypocrites and the deceivers; the children of the Canaanites, filled with complete wickedness and abominations, their deeds were evil and many.
ፈጣሪያቸው እግዚአብሔር የሚወድደው ሥራ ሁሉ በእነርሱ ዘንድ አልነበረም።
ዳግመኛም ስሙ ብኤል ፌጎር የሚባል ጣዖትን ያመልኩ ነበር፤ እንደ ፈጣሪያቸው እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ያመልኩትና ይታመኑት ነበር። እርሱ ግን ደንቆሮና ዲዳ ስለሆነ የሚያየውና የሚሰማው የለም፤ የሰው እጅ ሥራ ጣዖት ነውና፤ ብርና ወርቅን የሚሠራ አንጥረኛ የሠራው፥ ትንፋሽና ዕውቀት የሌለው የሰው እጅ ሥራ ነው፤
አይበላም፤ አይጠጣምም።
አይገድልም፦ አያድንምም።
አይተክልም፦ አይነቅልምም።
መልካም አያደርግም፤ ክፉም አያደርግም።
አያደኸይም፦ አያከብርምም።
አይቀሥፍም፤ ይቅርም አይልም። ነገር ግን ሰነፎች የከለዳውያንን ሕዝብ ለማሳት ዕንቅፋትን ይሆናል።
The enemies of the Lord are the proud, the deceitful priests, and the servants of their idols, who are consumed.
They were to offer sacrifices to them; and they were to be appeased by them.
They were as those who eat and drink.

In every feast, they were to provide for the lambs and the goats, the fatted calves and the bullocks; both morning and evening, sacrifices were to be offered; and thereafter, they were to consume the sacrifices that had been presented.
And the priests of the idols were to offer sacrifices, so that they might draw others to them and lead them astray; yet they alone were not the ones who would do so.

As for the children of the dead, they were as if they were alive, and when their Creator, the Lord, was to be honored, the priests of the idols would instruct them to offer sacrifices and to consume the sacrifices that had been presented; but these children of the dead were indeed not to be found.
They keep the command of their father; they have been steadfast in doing good works; and they fear the Lord, thus they are worthy of being gathered together.
In their distress and in their exile, at the time of their calamity,
they said to the king, "Do not offer sacrifices to the idols, nor perform the rites."
Therefore the king was angry; he was distressed; and he commanded that they be brought before him; and he said to them, "Offer sacrifices to the idols; and do not offer the sacrifices."
And they answered him, saying, “We will not return to you concerning this matter; we will not offer sacrifices to your gods nor will we serve them.”
They were greatly troubled by many works; yet, they believed in the Lord, and their hearts were distressed, so they could not prevail.
And fire consumed them, and they gave their souls to the Lord.
After death, they became alive, and bearing their drawn swords, they lay in the palace, and at night they were seen; and He was utterly afraid.
And He said unto them, “Masters, be it so; what shall I do for you? Whatever you command me, I will do; but do not take my life.” And they hastened to compel him.

They said, “Consider that the Lord is your Creator,” and they spoke all that was fitting; “From this, your pride will lead you down to the abyss with your father, the devil; and there, you will not have a sinless sin, while we are praising our Creator, the Lord, and while we are trembling at His divinity, you will consume all your offerings as if you were burned in fire.”
For He is the Creator of all, of heaven and earth, of the sea and all that is within it.
The sun and the moon, the stars and all creatures, He alone is the Lord God who created them.

“In heaven above and on earth beneath, there is no other god besides Him; He alone is able to do all things, and there is none who can oppose Him. He is the one who kills and makes alive, who brings low and lifts up.”
He is the one who rules over heaven and earth, and there is none who can deliver from His hand.

From you, the sinner and your father, Satan has led their hearts astray; as for you, there is none who has come forth from the creation he has made, except for the sinners. You and your idols shall descend together into the abyss, even unto everlasting destruction.
It is indeed your teacher, Satan, who has taught you to do evil, that you may commit wicked deeds; for you alone are not the one who does them.
You have not considered your Creator, O God; you act as if you are your own creator, like unto God Himself.
Until the Lord cast you down, you shall be ensnared by your own works and by your idols; for on the earth, because of the sins you have committed and in all your transgressions, you shall be judged.

Woe unto you, who do not know your Creator, the Lord God, and who do not keep His commandments and His word! When you are taken captive in Sheol, you shall cry out in vain, for you have no one to save you.

Your soul and spirit, for the evil you have committed, shall not be spared; and for the good you have done, you shall not be rewarded. As you have served your idols, so shall you be treated by them, and you and your priests shall have no escape from her.
You and your servants of your idols, you shall be led to the fire of hell, for the hearts of the wicked are like yours, and the devil speaks within them; their works are the works of man.
Know that there is none who will save you, and you shall perish; you shall be in despair.
For your sustenance, the Lord has created beasts, cattle, and dogs; they shall be better than you, for they have no eternal punishment except for death.
But you shall die; and even unto eternity, there shall be no escape for you, and in hell you shall be tormented.
Thus they spoke and went; and they were cast out from Him.
That little one, however, was seized with great fear and trembled, for he did not cease until he was delivered.

After this, he went to the place where the righteous are gathered; but he found them not, for they were taken away. But he went, lest his soul be taken, for the Lord had delivered them, and he was cast out.
He went forth in pride and in heart.
And in his kingdom, it is said that Daniel saw a strong iron, and he surrounded the nations of the peoples.
In all tribulation and in all affliction, he shall dwell in torment.
He shall gather what was spoken before, he shall bring it low; he shall consume it.
His neck is as a serpent, as his father, as the devil, and he is a scourge that is cast away, and what remains shall be trampled underfoot.
Even God, the Creator, is not known as He is; yet, it is said that my time is as the heavens, it has become.
In his heart, the sun shall rise as it goes forth from him.

By strength, he shall rise; by the fire of the Zablon, he shall be consumed; in Macedonia, he shall raise a battle; from Samaria, he shall receive the color; from Syria, they shall give him the hand of the oppressor.

In the regions of the everlasting, he shall be consumed; until Sidon, he shall arrive; in Achaia, he shall take the tax; until the sea of Phesashu, his neck shall be lifted high; he shall return and send his message until the sea of Hindek.
Likewise, he shall lift his neck high until the heavens.
He shall dwell in the midst of affliction and calamity, yet he shall not forsake himself.
His path leads all to darkness and to the abyss, to iniquity and to affliction, to blood and to destruction and to suffering.
Every path is that which the Lord God pursues; it is the teacher of the oppressed and of the wicked, as he has instructed; he shall call upon the poor; he shall not turn away from the needy.
He has taken the kings of the nations in his hand and has slain them.
He has subdued the leaders of the enemies; he has subdued many nations; as he has shed blood, so he has slaughtered them.
Mercy has not been shown; from the sea of Tarshish to the sea of Jericho, there has been none unpunished.

For idols, he was to be worshipped; he caused death and bloodshed, he who struck down the father and devoured what was offered to idols; in all his works, there was no judgment, but complete wrath and contention, for there was no judgment. Under his authority, the nations were made to tremble, as he imposed tribute upon them.
Before him, he shall do all that he desires, and before him, there was no fear of God; he was to dwell in the presence of the Creator, before the Lord God, in arrogance.
As the Creator, he was not to act. The Lord God, in his wrath, at the appointed time, shall repay the evil done to his adversary.

The Lord shall erase the names of the proud from this world, and I shall destroy the arrogant who do not abide by my command; I shall destroy them, as I have previously destroyed the mighty. In due time, he shall bring them to ruin.
The wicked shall receive their due as they have done evil.
But the righteous shall be guided in goodness by the Lord God.

And Joshua, on one day, caused to perish the five kings of the Canaanites, and their armies, as he prayed, the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and until he had destroyed the armies of Ai and of the Canaanites, of the Perizzites and of the Hivites, and of the Jebusites, so that the sun remained in the sky, and at one time about twenty thousand men fell, and they were destroyed, as they were smitten, and their feet were made as dust, and in battle they were slain, and the hailstones fell upon them.
Those who cause grief to the Lord God through their evil deeds shall find themselves in such affliction.
እግዚአብሔር ያይደለህ አንተ ደካማ ሰው ሆይ! ለምን ትኰራለህ? ዛሬ ሰው ነህ፤ ነገም መሬትና ዐመድ ነህ፤ በመቃብርህም ትልና ብስባሽ ትሆናለህ።
ዳግመኛም አንተንና የአንተን ሥራ የሚሠሩትን ሲኦል ትከተላቸዋለች፤ የአንተ መምህር አባታችን አዳምን ስለ አሳተ የዐለምን ሁሉ ኀጢአት ወደ ራሱ የሚመልስ ሰብልያኖስ ነውና፤
ራሱንም በማኵራትና ልቡናውን በማደንደን ለፈጣሪው ሥራ መስገድን እንቢ ብሏልና።
አንተም እንደ መምህርህ ለፈጣሪህ ለእግዚአብሔር መስገድን እንቢ ብለሃል።
አንተም ፈጣሪያቸው እግዚአብሔርን የማያውቁት የቀደሙህ እንደ ሄዱት ትሄዳለህ፤
በምድር ስለ ሠሩት ስለ ክፉ ሥራቸው እንደ ተበቀላቸውና ወደ ሲኦል እንደ ወረዱ፥
አንተም እንደ እነርሱ ወደ ገሃነም ትወርዳለህ።
ቍጣውንም አነሣሥተሃልና፥ በአምስቱም መንግሥታት ላይ ሥልጣንን የሰጠህ እግዚአብሔርን ማምለክ ቸል ብለሃልና፥ ከእግዚአብሔር እጅ የምታመልጥ ይመስልሃልን?
ፈቃዱንም ታደርግ እንደ ሆነ፥ አታደርግም እንደ ሆነ መረመረህ፤ በምድርም መንገድህን ብታሣምር እግዚአብሔር መንገድህን ያከናውንልሃል፤ እጅህንም ያኖርህበትን ሁሉ ያከናውንልሃል፤ ይባርክልሃልም፤ ጥንተ ጠላቶችህንና የዕለት ጠላቶችህንም ያስገዛልሃል።
በመውጣትህና በመግባትህ፥ በሆድህም ፍሬ፥ በመንጋዎችህና በድልቦችህም፥ በጣቶችህም በአመለከትህበት ሥራ ሁሉ፥ በልብህም ባሰብኸው ሁሉ ደስ ይልሃል፤ እንዲህ ታደርግ ዘንድ፥ ትሠራና ትተክል፥ ታፈርስም ዘንድ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሥልጣን ተሰጥቶሃልና ሁሉ ይታዘዝልሃል።

Yet, if thou dost refuse to hear the word and law of the Lord, and if thou dost dwell in judgment, all judgment is truth, for it was before thee, and as it is fitting, so the Lord shall not be regarded as one who does not regard, and in the day of judgment, the wicked shall not find refuge from the hand of the Lord.
There is none that can hide from His face; yet, all is fully revealed before Him.
He is the one who bears the authority of the rulers and reveals the throne of the mighty.
He is the one who lifts up the fallen and raises those who have been cast down.

He is the one who redeems the captives; He is the one who revives the dead; for the cry for mercy is from Him, and their flesh has decayed and been shattered, like those who have been slain, He shall revive them in the time of their downfall.
For He is grieved, and He shall restore those who have done evil; He shall deliver them.
Upon the earth, He shall destroy their seed; for they have transgressed the law and the commandments of the Lord.
The way of the righteous is more excellent than the way of the wicked; therefore, the wicked shall not dwell in the counsel of the righteous.
As the heavens are higher than the earth, so is the way of the righteous higher than the way of the wicked.
But the way of the wicked is one of destruction and calamity, of death and mourning, of strife and contention; it is a way of destruction and the place of man's wealth shall be laid waste.

The shedding of man's blood, hastening to cause destruction, committing unprofitable harm, oppressing the poor, consuming blood and death, eating the flesh of the ungodly and the wicked, and slaying a woman who is with child and in labor, this is an abomination.
All these are the works of iniquity, a broad way that leads to everlasting destruction and punishment, and it is a path that is adorned by the devil.

But the path of the righteous, though narrow and straitened, leads to life, to righteousness and humility, to love and peace, to fasting and prayer, and to the purity of the flesh; it leads away from that which is unprofitable, from consuming that which is struck down and that which brings death, and from the slaying of a wife and the mourning of a widow to the way of preservation.
Sinners, indeed, will do all these things, and they shall be far from the law; they shall partake of every abominable act and foul food, but the Lord shall keep them from all that He does not love.
The righteous shall flee from every way that the Lord does not love.
He will love them; from all their afflictions, He will guard them like a treasure; He will also deliver them.
But the wicked shall be possessed by the devil. They shall keep the law and its commandments, and they shall be kept from all that is loved.
እናንተም ነገሥታቱና መኳንንቱ በሰይጣን ጎዳና አትሂዱ። ነገር ግን የፈጠራችሁን፥ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ የጠበቃችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ፍሩት።
ሁሉንም በሚገዛ በእግዚአብሔር ሕግና ትእዛዝ ጸንታችሁ ኑሩ።
የእስራኤል ልጆች የኬጤዎንንና የከናኔዎንን፥ የፌርዜዎንንም ሀገር ይወርሱ ዘንድ ወደ አማሌቅ በመጡ ጊዜ የሴፎር ልጅ ባላቅ፥
በለዓምን፥ “አንተ የረገምኸው የተረገመ፥ የመረቅኸውም የተመረቀ ነውና ትረግምልኝ ዘንድ ና፤ እኔም የሚያከብርህን ብዙ ወርቅና ብር እሰጥሃለሁ” ብሎታልና።
በለዓምም የጥንቆላውን ዋጋ ተስፋ አድርጎ መጣ፤ የሴፎር ልጅ ባላቅም የእስራኤል ልጆች የሰፈሩበትን ቦታ አሳየው፤
ሟርቱንም አደረገ፤ መሥዋዕቱንም ሠዋ፤ የሰቡትንም ላሞችንና በጎችን አረደ፤ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ይረግማቸው ዘንድ ወደደ።
እግዚአብሔር ግን ይረግማቸው ዘንድ አልወደደም፤ ርግማንን ወደ ምርቃት በቃሉ መለሳት እንጂ።
እንዲህም አለ፥ “አንተ እግዚአብሔር የመረጠው ሕዝብ ነህና፥ ከሰማይ የሚመጣ የፍቁር ማደሪያም ነህና የሚመርቁህ የተመረቁ ይሁኑ፤ የሚረግሙህም የተረገሙ ይሁኑ” አለ።
ከዚህም በኋላ በፊቱ በመረቃቸው ጊዜ የሴፎር ልጅ ባላቅ አዘነ፤ ፈጽሞም ተቈጣ፤ ይረግማቸውም ዘንድ አዘዘ።
በለዓምም፥ “እግዚአብሔር የመረቀው ወገን ወደዚህ ሀገር መጥትዋልና እግዚአብሔር የመረቃቸውን እኔ አልረግምም” አለው።

The son of Sehor said to Balak, “I was indeed ready to curse you, but you did not allow me to curse them; you have hastened to bless them before me; and if you were to ask me to curse them, I would have given you a house full of gold and silver; yet you have hastened to bless them; you have done no good for me, and I too have done no good for you.”
And Balak said, “I will speak the word that the Lord has put in my mouth; I cannot speak the word of the Lord to curse or to change it.”
I too do not love money; for if I loved money, I would not be cursed, for the Lord would surely be angry with me,” he said.
The Lord said to their father Jacob, “Let those who bless you be blessed; let those who curse you be cursed.”
All who bless you are indeed blessed; without judgment, all who curse you are cursed; the Lord loves you and will establish your way and your work.
And as they have grieved the Lord in their wickedness, He will not allow them to be like the people of old; they have been swept away by destruction.
Their enemies have overwhelmed them; calamity has beset them, and their evil has brought forth enemies, leading their kings along with their priests and prophets to destruction.
And they have gone to a land they do not know; they have hastened to their destruction; they have been scattered; and their land has been laid waste.
They have destroyed the city of the holy ones and have turned it into ruins, and they have made Jerusalem like a field.
The priests have been destroyed; the law has been forsaken; and the warriors have fallen in battle.
ባልቴቶችም ተማረኩ፤ ለሞቱ ባሎቻቸውም አላለቀሱም፤ ተማርከዋልና ለራሳቸው አለቀሱ፤
ሕፃናትም አለቀሱ፤ ሽማግሎችም አፈሩ፤ የሽማግሌውንና የሽበታሙን ፊት አልራሩም።
ለቆንጆዎችና በሕግ ላሉም አልራሩም፤ በአገራቸው ያገኙትንም ሁሉ አጠፉ፤ ቤተ መቅደስን አስቀድሞ ያፈርስ ዘንድ በወደደ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ወገኖቹን ተቈጥትዋልና ወደማያውቁት ወደ ባዕድ ሀገር ማርከው ወሰዷቸው።
ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤልን ልጆች ቸል ባላቸው ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን እንደ እርሻ እንድትታረስ አደረጋት፤ ሁልጊዜ ፈጣሪያቸውን ያሳዝኑታልና።
እርሱ ግን በምንም አንድ ጊዜ አላጠፋቸውም፤ ስለ አባቶቻቸው ይራራላቸዋልና የሚራራላቸው ስለ ራሳቸው አይደለም። በእውነት የነገሡ፥ በፈጣሪያቸውም ፊት በቀና ሕግ ጸንተው የኖሩ አባቶቻቸውን አብርሃምንና ይስሐቅን ያዕቆብንም ይወዳቸዋልና ነው እንጂ።
እርሱም እጥፍ በሆነ ክብር ላይ ሾማቸው፤ በሰማይና በምድር ያለ ሁለት መንግሥትንም አገኙ።
እንዲሁም በሚያልፍ በዚህ ዓለም የምትኖሩ እናንተ ነገሥታቱና መኳንንቱ በሚገባ ሥራ ጸንተው የኖሩ ከእናንተ አስቀድሞ የነበሩ አባቶቻችሁ መንግሥተ ሰማያትን እንደ ወረሱ፥ ስማቸው ለልጅ ልጅ ያማረ እንደ ሆነ አስቧቸው።
አንተም መንግሥትህን ያቀናልህ ዘንድ መልካም አኑዋኑዋራቸው እግዚአብሔርን እንዳገለገሉት ከአንተ አስቀድሞ እንደ ነበሩ እንደ ደጋጎች ነገሥታት ስምህን መልካም ያደርግልህ ዘንድ ሥራህን አቅና።

Consider the servant of the Lord, Moses; in his prayers and in his humility, he did not neglect to keep this people, nor did he destroy them; but rather, for the sake of the dead, the Lord would destroy them all at once, for the sake of their brother and sister, according to their kind, before the Lord, he admonished them concerning their sins, saying, “O Lord, your people have sinned before you, and forgive your people; let it not be a burden upon them.”
“Before you, I am a sinner, and I am your servant; forgive me; for you are merciful, and let it not be a burden upon them, and for them also, have mercy upon them.”
Thus did Moses admonish the dead.
Therefore, it was said, “The dead.”
And the Lord was exceedingly displeased with the children of Korah and the other sons; and He would punish them, for He had made them like unto the Lord.

But the children of Korah who were scattered were cast down to the earth; while they were alive in body and soul, they were brought down to Sheol along with their flocks and their tents; for the Creator, the Lord, had loved them and would not depart from His command, and every word that was spoken would be done as the word of the Lord.
Likewise, if you do not keep the command of the Lord, the Lord will fulfill your desire; but He will also love you; He will keep your kingdom.
The children of Korah and Abiram who departed from the command of Moses, for the Lord had not given them a heart to serve Him, they did not stir in Him.
“Are we not the sons of Levi who serve in the house of the priesthood?” they said.

And they took hold of their inquiry; they went and took hold; but the Lord did not accept their prayers; in their inquiry, fire consumed them; they were consumed by fire as one who is burned; and of them, not one remained; “Their inquiry has consumed them in their flesh,” it was said, and when they entered into the dwelling of the Lord, their garments and their bodies did not remain.
ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ አላቸው፥ “ጥናቸውን ወደ ድንኳን ሰብስቡ፤ ከውጭ ጀምሮ እስከ ውስጥ ድረስ ሁሉን ላዘጋጀሁለት ለቤቴ መሣሪያ ይሁን።”
የተቀደሰች የድንኳንዋንም መሣሪያ አዘጋጀ፤ መክደኛውንና ቀለበቱን፥ የኪሩቤልን ሥዕልና ባሕሩን አዘጋጀ።
ሰኑንና መጋረጃውን፥ ስክተቱንና የድንኳኑን ዙሪያ ዕድሞ፥ ጋኖችንና በምስክሩ ድንኳን የሚሠዉበት መሠዊያውን ሠራ።
የፈቃዱን መሥዋዕትና የሰላሙን መሥዋዕት፥ የስእለቱንና የኀጢአቱን መሥዋዕት፥ የማታውንና የጧቱንም መሥዋዕት ሠዉ።
ሥራ ይሠሩባት ዘንድ በምስክሩ ድንኳን ለሙሴ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አዘዛቸው።
ማርና ወተትን የምታስገኝ፥ ለአብርሃም የማለለትን፥ ያባቶቻቸውን ርስት ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ተስፋ በሰጣቸው በፈጣሪያቸው በእግዚአብሔር በሕጉ ድንኳን ውስጥ ስሙ በእነርሱ ይመሰገን ዘንድ ለአምላካቸው መገዛትን አላቃለሉም።
ለይስሐቅ ማለለት፤ ለያዕቆብም አምልኮቱን አጸናለት።
በምስክሩ ድንኳንም ለሙሴና ለአሮን አጸናላቸው፥
በኢየሩሳሌም በድንኳኑና ሰሎሞን በሠራው ቤተ መቅደስ የእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ፥ የልዑልም የስሙ ማረፊያ፥ የእስራኤልም ቅዱስ ማደሪያ እስኪሆን ድረስ ለሳሙኤልና ለኤልያስ አምልኮቱን አጸናላቸው።
በየዋህነት ለሚኖሩ ለካህናቱ የሚገለጥባት መለመኛና የኀጢአት ማስተስረያ ናትና።
ፈቃዱንም ለሚያደርጉ ሰዎች ልመናቸውን የሚሰማባት ቦታ ናት።
የእስራኤልም ቅዱስ የእግዚአብሔር ሕጉ የሚሠራባት ናትና።
ለእስራኤል ቅዱስ ለእግዚአብሔር በጎ መዓዛ ሊሆን መሥዋዕት የሚሠዋባት፥ ዕጣንም የሚታጠንባት ናትና።
በምስክሩ ድንኳን ውስጥም ይቅር በሚልበት በመክደኛው ላይ ሆኖ ይናገር ነበር፤ ለመረጣቸው ለያዕቆብ ልጆች፥ በእግዚአብሔር በሕጉና በትእዛዙ ጸንተው ለሚኖሩ ለቅዱሳኑም የእግዚአብሔር ብርሃኑ ይገለጥላቸው ነበር።
የሚገዳደሩ ግን ምድር እንዳሰጠመቻቸው እንደ ቆሬ ልጆች ይሆናሉ፤ እንዲሁም ኃጥኣን እስከ ዘለዓለም ድረስ መውጫ ወደሌላት ወደ ገሃነም እሳት ይገቡ ዘንድ አላቸው።

Do not be concerned about what you have gathered in your dwelling; except for the will of yourselves, you have not fulfilled the will of the mighty of Israel! This is indeed pride and arrogance, drunkenness and intoxication, and it is to be ensnared by falsehood.

Therefore, my wrath shall be poured out like fire upon you, and it shall rage against you like a consuming flame; it shall rise against the mountains like a fire, and it shall consume the dwelling of the forsaken, and it shall ascend from the earth to that which cannot be found, even to the heavens, like a whirlwind.
Thus saith the Holy One of Israel, "I will utterly destroy all who work iniquity. Consider the Lord God, who is able to redeem all; there is none who can escape."
He will love those whom He loves; and those who walk in His command, He will forgive their transgressions and their iniquities; do not be like the wicked of the world and the deceitful of heart.
Prepare your hearts for the Lord; guard your souls that you may trust in Him; and in the day of your affliction, I will deliver you from the hand of your adversaries.

When you call upon me, behold, I am with you; I will deliver you from your enemies; for you have believed in me, and you have obeyed my command, and you have not departed from my law; for I love you, and in the day of your affliction, I will not forsake you, saith the Lord God who is able to redeem all.
He will love those whom He loves; for He is gracious and merciful, and He will keep those who keep His command.

His wrath shall often be turned away from them; for they are known to be flesh and blood, and therefore He is merciful; in all His sanctifications, He will not destroy them; their souls shall return to their earthliness at the appointed time.
For they have fled from existence, and concerning their existence, the Lord will not know until He loves them; He has taken their souls; He has returned the earthly nature to its ground.
Again, if there is no existence, He will bring them to existence.
The Lord, having been provoked, increased His wrath before the face of the Lord; even until the day of His visitation, He exalted Himself greatly.
Thus He spoke, "My time is as the heavens; I am He who brings forth the sun; even unto eternity shall I not die."

And having spoken this matter, without ceasing, there came a messenger of death, whose name was Tselimiyako, and he struck his heart; and at that hour he died; for he did not give thanks to his Creator, and because of the multitude of his pride, he was separated from his labor and perished from his wretched life.

The army of the king of the Chaldeans, however, was to go forth and besiege, and while they were outside the city and the land, at the time of his death, they departed and laid waste his land; they spared not even a single one, from the young man to the old.
They plundered all the wealth; they took their possessions; and they set the city on fire and returned to their own land.
The five sons of Amenu, however, did not partake of the offerings that were sacrificed to idols, but they delivered their bodies to death.
This world, as it is fleeting and as it passes away, let them know that it does not endure forever; thus, they surrendered their bodies to the fire, as it is known from heaven.
Just as one may be punished for slaying a man, so too does the wrath of God come upon those who provoke Him, for it is known that the wrath of the King is akin to the wrath of God.
"O Lord, it is better to dwell in heaven for one day than to endure many years on earth; and it is more fitting to seek Your forgiveness for one hour than for many ages."
What is our time, O men? Is it not like a fleeting shadow, and does it not vanish like smoke in the fire?
"But You, O Lord, endure forever; Your time does not pass away; Your name is proclaimed from generation to generation."
And the sons of the martyrs, they chose to endure all that was like them; they chose to trust in God, and they said, "Let us not partake of the unclean offerings."
Therefore, just as the dead shall rise, and after resurrection, judgment shall be rendered; they surrendered their bodies for the sake of their faith in God.

O you who do not know the resurrection of the dead and do not believe! Know that their life is greater than the earthly life; they surrendered their bodies to death in unity, and their brotherhood arose from among these five.

Let all know that they shall pass away because they believed; and because they did not yield to idols, and because they did not partake of the offerings of the dead and the defiled, they surrendered their bodies to death in order to receive the praise of God.

Therefore, in the latter days, when the soul and the flesh rejoice as a wife and children do, they did not know the sweetness of this world and the bitterness of death; and in the latter days, they gave their bodies to death, knowing that a resurrection would be made in the soul and in the flesh.
Those who kept the commandments of the Lord, sickness and sorrow, and death shall not be in the world to come for the children and the children's children and for a long time.
Know that the word of the Lord is spoken with kings and princes, and yet they do not perceive what is to be done in their hearts; they gave their bodies to death as if they were in the midst of fire.

Their faces shine as the sun shines in its strength; all shall rejoice in their souls and in their flesh at the time of their rising, and they gave their bodies to death, hoping that love would speak to them.
የአይሁድና የሳምራውያን፥ የፈሪሳውያንና የሙታንን ትንሣኤ የማያምኑ የሰዱቃውያን ነገር እኔን እጅግ ያሳዝነኛል፤ ልቡናዬም ያውቀዋል። አይሁድ፦ እንብላ፤ እንጠጣም፤ ነገም እንሞታለን፤ በዚያም የምናየው የለም ይላሉ።
ሳምራውያን ግን ሥጋችን ትቢያ ይሆናልና አይነሣም ይላሉ።
ትንሣኤም በተደረገ ጊዜ የነፍሳችንን መነሣት እናምናለን። ነፍስ እንደ ነፋስ የማትታይና እንደ ነጐድጓድ ድምፅ ስለ ሆነች እነሆ እዚህ አለች የማይሏትና የማትታይ ስለ ሆነች ሥጋ ቢሞት አትሞትምና።
ሥጋችን ግን በሁሉ ትታያለች፤ ዐመድና ትቢያም ትሆናለች። አውሬዎች ይበሏታልና፥ ትሎችም በመቃብር ይበሏታልና።
እነዚያም የበሏት እንደ ሣር ይሆናሉና፥ እንዳልተፈጠሩም ትቢያ ይሆናሉና ዐመድ ይሆናሉ፤ ፍለጋቸውም አይገኝም። የፈረሱ ሥጋዎች የት ይገኛሉ?
ፈሪሳውያንም እንዲህ ይላሉ፥ “የሙታንን መነሣት እናምናለን፤ ነገር ግን ነፍሳትን በምድር ያይደለ በሰማያት ሌላ ሥጋ ያለብሳቸዋል።”
ሰዱቃውያንም እንዲህ ይላሉ፥ “ነፍሳችን ከሥጋችን ከወጣች በኋላ ከሞት አንነሣም፤ ለነፍስና ለሥጋም ትንሣኤ የላቸውም፤ ከሞትንም በኋላ አንነሣም።”
ስለዚህም እጅግ ፈጽመው ይስታሉ፤ በእግዚአብሔርና በጌትነቱም ላይ ጽርፈትን ይናገራሉና የእነርሱ ነገር ያሳዝነኛል።
የሚያጸድቃቸው እግዚአብሔርንም አላመኑትምና ለመዳን ተስፋ የላቸውም፤ ለመዳንና ከሙታን ለመነሣትም ተስፋ የላቸውም።
አንተ ዕውር አይሁዳዊ ካለመኖር የፈጠረህን፥ እንደ ምራቅም ስትሆን ሰው ያደረገህን እግዚአብሔርን አላዋቂ ታደርገዋለህን? በምሳሌውና በመልኩ የፈጠረህ ነፍስህንና ሥጋህን አዋሕዶ ማስነሣት ይሳነዋልን?

Thou shalt not be ensnared by the hand of the Lord, nor think thus; for if thou art not loved, thou shalt rise; and in thy death, the cord of Sheol is upon thy neck, and if thou art not loved, it shall deliver thee.

This cord that is bound upon thy neck shall be a refuge for thee from the womb of thy mother, for it shall protect thee from the depths of Sheol. And in the time of thy distress, she too shall deliver thee.
Even in thy death, it shall dwell upon thy neck; and in the time of thy distress, she shall bring forth her offspring; and she shall remember her branches.
All the wicked are as cords upon their necks, for they are entangled within themselves.
And the souls of the wicked shall come forth from the threshold of heaven; thus, if thy cord is upon thy soul, it shall bring thee down to Sheol.

And thy flesh, when it is separated from thy soul, shall be as the flesh of our father Adam, perfect and pure, and by the mercy of God, it shall rise. And then, as thou hast wrought in sin and transgression, thou shalt receive thy reward.

Let not thy thoughts be solely for another; for thou shalt also be forsaken, and in thy error, thou shalt dwell in the grave; and from God, thou shalt depart, and thou shalt say that there is no resurrection for the dead.
As thou hast wrought, so shall thy reward be given unto thee; for who shall forsake thee in the place of thy dwelling and in the midst of thy years?
Yet, if there be a wind in the air, or if there be water in the sea, or if there be earth upon the ground, or if there be fire in the flames, it shall come forth.
That which thou hast done, even if thy soul dwells in darkness, it shall surely come forth.
በገነት በደስታ የሚኖሩ የጻድቃን ነፍሳትም ይመጣሉ።
አንተም አይሁዳዊ፥ አንተም ሳምራዊ፥ አንተም ፈሪሳዊ፥ አንተም ሰዱቃዊ እስኪፈረድብህ ድረስ በጨለማ ትኖራለህ።
ያንጊዜም ሰውን ስለ አሳትህ እንደ ሥራህ እግዚአብሔር እንደሚከፍልህ ታያለህ።
እንዲህም ትላቸዋለህ፦ የሞቱ ሰዎች አይነሡም፤ ነገ እንሞታለንና እንብላ፤ እንጠጣም፤ በሙሴም ወንበር ተቀምጠህ በቃልህ የሙታን ትንሣኤ የለም ትላለህ።
ስለዚህም የኦሪትን መጽሐፍ እያወቅህ፥ የመጻሕፍትንም ቃል እያስተማርህ ሳትህ፤ ሰውን ከምታስት ሳትማር በቀረህ ይሻል ነበር።
በክፉ ትምህርትህና በማይጠቅም ቃልህ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕዝብ ከምታስክድ የመጻሕፍትን ቃል በአላወቅህ ይሻልህ ነበር።
አንተ ግን እንደ ሥራህና እንደ ከንፈርህ ፍሬ ይሰጥሃል፤ እግዚአብሔር ፊት አይቶ አያዳላምና፥ በጎ ሥራንም ለሚያስተምሩ ለወዳጆቹ ከአዘጋጀው ጸጋ ይሰጣቸዋልና።
አንተም ከሚፈረድብህ ከእግዚአብሔር እጅ የምታመልጥበት የለም፤ እንደ ሥራህም ይከፍልህ ዘንድ አለው፤ አንተና ያስተማርሃቸውም በአንድነት ይፈረድባችኋል።
ሙታን እንደሚነሡም ዕወቅ፤ ሕጉን የጠበቁ ቢሆኑም ይነሣሉ፤ በመቃብር መቈየት አይችሉም፤ ዝናም በዘነመ ጊዜ ምድር ሣርን እንደምታወጣ ትእዛዙ ያወጣቸዋልና።
ዝናም ምድርን ባጠገባት ጊዜ ርጥብ እንጨት ቅጠልን እንደምታወጣ፥ ስንዴም ፍሬን እንደምታፈራ፥ እህልም ዝርዝርን እንደምታስገኝ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከወደደ ፍሬዋን ትከለክል ዘንድ እንደማትችል፥
And when the woman who has conceived is in labor, she cannot cease her travail, nor can she refrain from giving birth.

The earth likewise shall bring forth that which has been gathered within her; and after she has heard the word of the Lord, she shall not be able to cease her travail, yet behold, the command of the Lord shall descend upon her, and at once she shall bring forth.
The bodies shall gather in their appointed places; the houses of the souls shall be opened; and the souls shall return to their bodies, as they were before.
And at the time of resurrection, the dead shall rise like a flash of lightning; and before the Lord they shall stand, and according to their deeds shall they be rewarded.

At that time, as you rise with the dead, you shall see; all the works you have done upon the earth shall be brought to remembrance; and in the sight of your eyes, as they are written, you shall behold a glory that shall not fade away.
As you rise with the dead, so shall you know the work you have done.

Blessed are those who shall receive their good works; for they shall rejoice at that time. But the wicked, who do not benefit from their deeds, shall be as those who rise in the hour of their distress.
The works they have done shall be judged; and they themselves shall know, without any accuser, how they shall be judged.
On the day of reckoning and judgment, on the day of the great judgment, they shall stand in the place where the righteous shall be gathered.
On the day of utter darkness, on the day of gloom, on the day of brightness, on the day of light,
On the day of fear and trembling, on the day of cold and heat, on the day of distress,
The wicked shall receive their reward as they have wrought evil; and the righteous shall receive their reward as they have done good, and the sinner shall receive his due as he has committed sin.
The master shall not be honored on that day, nor shall the mother be honored by her servant at that time.
The king shall not be honored by the poor at that time, nor shall the noble be honored by the child, nor shall the father be honored by his son, nor shall the mother be honored by her child.

The wealthy shall not be honored by the poor at that time, nor shall the proud be honored by the humble, nor shall the great be honored by the small; for it is the day of judgment, the day of reward and punishment, and all shall receive according to their works.
It is the day when those who have done good shall receive their reward, and those who have done evil shall receive their due.

The day when they shall receive their reward is a day of joy for them, and the day when they shall bear the burden of evil is a day of sorrow for them. They shall say, "The dead do not rise," and thus they shall reflect upon the scriptures.
At that time, the mighty of the earth shall lament for their sins, and because they did not do good while upon the earth, they shall be filled with sorrow for the lack of repentance.
Likewise, while upon the earth, they have done good works, and the joy of those who have performed good deeds shall not cease until eternity.
For they know that as the dead rise, they shall not depart from their Creator's law.
Because they did not depart from the commandment, they shall inherit two lives; upon the earth, they shall multiply their seed, and their children shall be blessed.
In the heavens, on the day of resurrection, when the righteous are gathered, they shall inherit the kingdom of heaven, which is prepared for their fathers.
Those who do evil and do not believe in the resurrection of the dead, who do not consider the law of God and the day of resurrection, shall be filled with sorrow.
At that time, the end shall be for those who have no refuge, and the affliction they shall encounter shall be without relief; and in their hearts, there shall be sorrow without comfort.
A fire that does not extinguish shall consume them, a flame that shall not be quenched shall seize them.
Their flesh shall be in a place of fire and torment, a place of great anguish, where the breath of the wind, the storm, and the cold shall overwhelm them.
The resurrection of the dead shall be unto those who do not believe, a fire of hell awaits them.

In thy flesh, in thy hand and in thy foot, until thou considerest the crown upon thy head; for in the time of their gathering, they shall hasten forth, that thy heart and mind may be prepared for belief in this knowledge.

These, thy hand and thy foot, the crown upon thy head, whence shall they come forth, dost thou say? As thou art aware of the resurrection from death, know that there is no resurrection in another flesh, but in thine own flesh; let it be known that the resurrection prepared by God is not in vain.

Thou also, saying there is no resurrection of the dead, because of thy deception, thy sin, and the iniquity thou hast wrought, at the time of the resurrection of the dead, thy portion shall be received.
Even now, when the day of thy portion has come upon thee, thou shalt see; whether it be wheat or barley, thou shalt not say that which is sown by thee shall be in vain.
Likewise, thou shalt not say that the vine which thou hast planted shall not bear fruit; whether it be a vine or a fig tree, its branches and its fruit shall not be cast away.

Whether thou plant the vine or the fig tree, it shall not be cast away; whether thou plant the fig tree or the vine, it shall not be cast away; whether thou sow wheat or barley, it shall not be cast away.

Whether thou sow barley or wheat, it shall not be cast away. Yet all shall yield according to its kind and its lineage, according to its fruit and its tree, according to its branch and its root; from God shall come forth the mercy that brings forth blessings.

Likewise, the earth shall hold the soul and the flesh as God hath sown; the flesh and soul of those who are sown shall arise, but those who have done good works shall not be cast away for the evil works done by others; nor shall the evil works of those who have done evil be cast away for the good works done by others.

At the hour when the trumpet shall sound, the dead shall arise from the mercy that is found with God; those who have done good works shall rise unto the resurrection of life; their reward shall be prepared by God for the righteous, free from sorrow and grief; and thereafter shall be a dwelling of the pure, a garden of joy where they shall not die again.
Yet those who have done evil works shall rise unto the resurrection of condemnation, along with their deceivers and the devil.
ከሰው ልጆች ሁሉ አንድ ሰው ስንኳ ይድን ዘንድ ከማይወዱ ከሠራዊቶቹ ከአጋንንትም ጋራ ወደ ዘለዓለም ቅጣት ይሄዳሉ፤
የጨለማ ዳርቻ ወደ ሆነ፥ ጥርስ ማፋጨትና ልቅሶ ወዳለበት፥ ይቅርታና ምሕረት ወደሌለበት፥ እስከ ዘለዓለም ድረስ መውጫ ወደሌለበት ወደ ገሃነም ይወርዳሉ። በሥጋቸው ሳሉ በምድር ላይ በሕይወታቸው በጎ ሥራ አልሠሩምና።
ስለዚህም ነፍስና ሥጋ በትንሣኤ ጊዜ ይፈረድባቸዋል።
እግዚአብሔር የተአምራቱን ብዛት የሚያሳይባት የነፍስና የሥጋን በአንድነት መነሣት ለማያምኑ ሰዎች ወዮላቸው!
ሁሉም እያንዳንዱ እንደ ሥራውና እንደ እጁ ድካም ዋጋውን ይቀበላል።
የስንዴ ቅንጣት ካልፈረሰች አትበቅልም፤ ፍሬም አታፈራም። የስንዴ ቅንጣት ብትፈርስ ግን ወደ ምድር ሥር ትሰዳለች፤ ቅጠልም ታወጣለች፤ ዝርዝርም ይሆናል፤ ፍሬም ያፈራል።
አንዲቱ የስንዴ ቅንጣት ብዙ ቅንጣት እንደምትሆን እናንተ ታውቃላችሁ።
እንደዚሁ ይህች ቅንጣት ከነፋስና ከውኃ፥ ከመሬትም የተነሣ ትበቅላለች፥ ፀሐይ ግን በእሳት ፋንታ ነው። ስንዴ ያለ ፀሐይ ፍሬ ማፍራት አይችልምና።
ነፋስም ስለ ነፍስ ፋንታ ነው፥ ያለ ነፋስም ስንዴ ማፍራት አይችልም፤ ውኃውም ምድርን ያጠጣታል፤ ያረካታልም።
መሬትም ውኃን ከጠጣች በኋላ ሥርን ታስገኛለች፤ ጫፏም ወደ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ትላለች፤ እግዚአብሔርም የባረካትን ያህል ታፈራለች።
የስንዴ ቅንጣት ግን እግዚአብሔር የፈጠራት ነባቢት ነፍስ ያደረችበት የአዳም አምሳል ነው፤ የወይን ግንድም እንደዚሁ ውኃ ይጠጣል፤ ሥርም ይሰድዳል፤ ቀጫጭኑ የሥሩ ገመድም ውኃን ይስባል።
ውኃዋንም ወደ ቅጠሎች ጫፍ ያወጣታል፤ ከእግዚአብሔር የተገኘ ጠል ረጃጅም የሐረጎችን ጫፎች ያጠጣቸዋልና። በፀሐይም ሙቀት ይዘረዝራል፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፈቃድ ፍሬን ያፈራል።
ልብን ደስ የሚያሰኝ በጎ መዓዛንም ያደርጋል፤ በበሉትም ጊዜ እንደማያስርብ እህልና እንደማያስጠማ ውኃ ያጠግባል፤ በጠመቁትም ጊዜ የወይን ጠጅ ይሆናል።
በጠጡትም ጊዜ “ወይን የሰውን ልብ ደስ ያሰኛል” ተብሎ በመዝሙር እንደ ተነገረ የሰውን ልብ ደስ ያሰኛል፤ ፈታ ፈታ ያለ ሰውም አፉን ከፍቶ በጠጣ ጊዜ ይሰክራል፤ በሳምባውም ይመላል፤ ደሙም ወደ ልቡ ይፈስሳል።
የወይን ስካር እጅግ ያስታልና አእምሮውን ያሳጣዋል፤ ጐጻጕጹንና ገደሉንም እንደ ሰፊ ሜዳ ያደርገዋል፤ በእጁና በእግሩ ያለውንም እንቅፋትና እሾህ አያውቅም።
And the Lord, in accordance with His will, has made it so that those who believe in the resurrection of the dead shall be praised, just as He has done with the vine and its fruit.
The resurrection of the dead brings joy to those who believe, for it is a dwelling place of life.

O ye who do not believe in the resurrection of the dead, how much error do ye embrace? And when ye are taken to that place which ye know not, at the time of your departure, for not believing in the resurrection of the dead in the unity of soul and body, ye shall cry out with a cry that shall not be heard in hell.
The dead, who are as pillars and cannot rise, we know, and ye shall remind your hearts of your beloved ones, and whether it be good or evil, ye shall receive the reward of your deeds.

Therefore, they shall be reminded of their beloved ones; for there is no rest for their death, and there is no strength for their burial; and in their weakness, they are not silent, and they have no place to stand before God.

In the time of their torment, when they are punished for the evil they have done, they shall greatly fear; for they shall speak without knowing the way of the Lord. They shall not know from whence they came.

They shall not know the way to hell; for their works, being evil and wicked, shall teach them as their hearts instruct their beloved ones; for they shall say that there is no resurrection of the dead.

At that time, they shall know that the dead rise; for they shall know that for all the children of man, there is a resurrection of the dead, for they do not believe that it shall be decreed upon them.
For we are all the children of Adam, and because of Adam, we have died; and we have all received the judgment of death from God because of the sin of our father Adam.
Therefore, we shall receive our reward in the work we have done; and then we shall rise together with our father Adam; for because of our father Adam, the world has been made subject to death.
Therefore, we shall receive the reward of Adam's transgression; and our flesh shall be laid in the grave; and our bones shall decay.
The earth hath swallowed our corruption; it hath consumed us; our blood hath been shed upon the ground; our flesh hath been received in the grave; and our bitter words have been buried in the earth.
ከሚያበሩ ዐይኖቻችንም ትሉ ወጣ፤ መልካችንም በመቃብር ጠፋ፤ ትቢያም ሆንን።
መልከ መልካም የነበሩ፥ ቁመታቸውም ያማረ፥ የቃላቸውም ንግግር የተቀላጠፈ የጐልማሶች የመልካቸው ደም ግባት ወዴት አለ? የአርበኞችስ ገናናነታቸው ወዴት አለ?
የነገሥታቱ ኀይላቸው፥ የመኳንንቱስ ክብራቸው ወዴት አለ? በፈረስ መጠረር፥ በወርቅና በብርም ማጌጥ፥ በሚያንጸባርቅ የጦር መሣሪያም መጠረር ወዴት አለ?
የመባልዕት ጣዕምና ጣፋጩ የወይን መጠጥ የት አለ?
O land that hath gathered together kings and queens, great ones and mighty ones, women of renown and fair maidens, woe unto thee, for thou hast risen from thee!

Those who have blood upon them, who are among the goodly, who possess knowledge and a heart, and whose words are as sweet as honey, as pleasant as the honeycomb, and as delightful as the years of plenty, woe unto thee!
Like the sweet wine that brings joy, they have a song that delights, and their eyes shine like the stars in the firmament.

Their right hands are strong to give and to lift, they are mighty in their deeds; their feet are swift to see, and like the well-ordered chariots, they are strong men who have gathered together, woe unto thee!
By the will of the Lord, we have been sent forth, and the souls of the goodly ones are not separated from their flesh; O death, woe unto thee, for thou hast risen from thee!

O land! The Lord hath gathered many souls unto thee and hath taken them back to thee; we have gathered many bodies from thee, woe unto thee! By the will of the Lord, we have gone forth from thee; and unto thee we shall return; and in the will of the Lord, we rejoice in thee.
Be thou a refuge for our souls; let us return unto thee; let us rest within thee; let us partake of thy fruits; and let us also feed our flesh upon thee.
Drink from thy fountain; and thou also drink from our blood's source; let us partake of the fruits of thy earth; and let us also feed our bones upon thee.
As the Lord hath commanded thee to be our food, let us eat of the good things of thy land; and thou also accept the blood of our flesh; and the Lord hath prepared a dwelling for thy food.

Many strong kings and queens have gathered unto thee; and the Lord who created them hath commanded thee, and from their youth and their glory, they have risen without fear; O death, that doth not spare the mighty, woe unto thee, for thou hast risen from thee!

Blessed are they who do not regard the poor; neither do they forsake the mighty and the strong; they do not neglect the rich and the needy, nor do they overlook the evil and the good, the widows and the children, the women and the men.

They do not forsake those who think well and those who have not transgressed the command; they do not neglect those who think evil like beasts in their deeds. In their goodness, they do not forsake those whose blood is pure, whose words and whose speech are of perfect taste.
They do not forsake those whose words are like a snare and whose mouths are filled with deceit; they have gathered their souls in both light and darkness.
The earth and the heavens shall remain until the time when the dead shall rise; even if it be in the grave, they shall gather their flesh.

The wicked shall receive the reward of their deeds as they have done; in the heavens, by the voice, and by the command of God, the dead shall rise like the eye of the storm, and those who have done good shall rejoice.
In fear and trembling, as we stand before Him, may all the works we have done upon the earth not be forgotten nor be cast away.
For our path, when we have not the strength to walk, and for our bodies, when we have no garment to wear,
For our hands, when we have no tool, and for our feet, when we have no shoes,
Whether it be a storm, or a tempest, or darkness, or a shadow, or the deep of the sea, or the depths of the abyss, at the time when we do not know the way that leads us,
We do not know those who will lead us; we do not hear their words.
For they are blind leaders, and they shall lead into darkness, and we shall not see their faces.

The prophet David spoke, saying, "My soul is upon me, in the time of my distress. O Lord, my God, You know my path; in this way that I have walked, I have turned to the right and seen; and he who knows me has forsaken me; there is none to help me."
And at the time he spoke this: as a man who is lost in the wilderness, and as one who knows not the way, it is known. And if he turns to the right or to the left, there is none who knows the way.
And he who knows him was not found; yet he was among the angels in darkness.
Let the souls of the righteous be received, that they may be brought to the place of the light of life, and the angels of light shall carry them to the place of rest.

Let them be received, for their sins have led them to receive the eternal punishment prepared for them, and to the souls of the wicked they shall be sent; yet the angels of glory and the righteous shall be with them.
Woe unto them, for they shall be delivered unto destruction; even if they find rest and wealth, their torment shall endure unto eternity, and they shall be cast out among the wicked souls.

For they have walked in the way of Cain, and in the greed of Balaam they have perished; they have turned aside from the good they ought to do. Their wealth, which is not theirs, they seize by violence, and they are led to accept bribes and gifts.
And they shall receive their reward in the fire of hell, as they have done their evil deeds.
የራሳቸው ገንዘብና የእጃቸው ሥራ ያልሆነውን የሌላውን ገንዘብ በዐመፅ የሚሰበስቡ ሰዎች ወዴት አሉ?
ያለ ዋጋ የሌላውን ገንዘብ ይወስዳሉና፥ የምትደርስባቸው ዕለተ ሞታቸውንም ሳያውቁ ይሰበስባሉና፥ ገንዘባቸውንም ለባዕድ ይተዋሉና።
ልጆቻቸውም በአባቶቻቸው ገንዘብ ደስ አይላቸውም፤ እንደ አባቶቻቸው እንደ እነርሱ ያሉ ኃጥኣንን በስርቆትም ቢሆን በቅሚያም ቢሆን፥ አስጨንቀው የሚይዙ የኃጥኣን ወገኖች ናቸውና።
የአባቶቻቸውም ገንዘብ አይጠቅማቸውም፤ በንጥቂያና በግፍ ሰብስበውላቸዋልና፤ እንደ ጉም ሽንትና ነፋስ እንደሚበትነው ጢስም፥ እንደሚረግፍ ሣርም፥ በእሳትም ፊት እንደሚቀልጥ ሰም እንዲሁ የኃጥኣን ክብራቸው ይጠፋል።
ዳዊትም እንደ ተናገረ፥ “ኀጢአተኛን እንደ ሊባኖስ ዛፍ ለምልሞና ከፍ ከፍ ብሎ አየሁት፤ በተመለስሁ ጊዜ ግን አጣሁት፤ ፈለግሁ፤ ቦታውንም አላገኘሁም።”
የማይሞቱ መስሏቸው የሌላውን ገንዘብ በግፍ ስለሚሰበስቡ ዛሬ ባልንጀሮቻቸውን የሚበድሉ ሰዎች እንዳይመኩ የኃጥኣን ጥፋታቸው እንደዚህ በአንድ ጊዜ ነው።
እናንተ ሰነፎች፥ እንደምታልፉ፥ ገንዘባችሁም ከእናንተ ጋር እንደሚያልፍ አስቡ፤ ወርቃችሁና ብራችሁ ቢበዛ የዛገ ይሆናል።
ልጆችን ብታበዙም የመቃብር ብዛት ይሆናል፤ ቤቶችንም ብታበዙ የፈረሰ ይሆናል።
የአምላካችሁ የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ አልፈጸማችሁምና ከብት ብታበዙም ለጠላቶቻችሁ ምርኮ ይሆናል፤ ያልተባረከ ሆኗልና፥ እጃችሁን ያኖራችሁበት ገንዘብ ሁሉ አይገኝም።
በቤትም ያለ ቢሆን፥ በዱርም ያለ ቢሆን፥ በመሰማሪያና በእርሻም ያለ ቢሆን፥ በእህል አውድማና በወይን መጭመቂያም ያለ ቢሆን አይገኝም።

And even if there be fruit in your bellies, you shall not rejoice; yet, from the sorrow that arises from your enemies, it shall be a burden upon you. Because you have not kept the command of the Lord your God, the Lord shall not be with you, nor shall He dwell among all your households.

But those who keep the law and the ordinances, and the commandments, He shall not withhold His blessings from them; He shall give them all that they desire; He shall bless the fruit of their land and the fruit of their bellies.
That they may be sold, but not that they may not be sold, He shall make them above all the nations that are around them; and in their dwelling place, He shall give them all His blessings.
In all that they possess, He shall bless them; the fruit of their fields and all the places of their flocks shall be blessed; and in their bellies, He shall bring them joy.
He shall not spare their cattle; from all their afflictions, from sickness and from weakness, from destruction, He shall deliver them, both from what they know and from what they do not know.

In the time of judgment, He shall protect them; from all evil and from affliction, from all that opposes them, He shall deliver them; if the work of the sanctuary is received with order by the Levite who keeps the work of the sanctuary, and if it goes according to the will of the Lord, according to the first law as is the law, they shall be given their due from the firstborn of man to the firstborn of cattle.

And Moses, as he commanded the son of Nineveh, until judgment is given to those who are judged, if there be a soul that is slain without knowledge or with knowledge, in that place, he shall be delivered, for in all their cities there was a city of refuge.
"Before him, as it was with him, in your hearts, consider that it is not with you;"

Whether it be a stone, whether it be a rock, whether it be wood, if it be said that a man has fallen from my hand without knowledge, let him say, 'I have died,' and let your inquiry be made; for he has acted without knowledge, and he shall be delivered.

If he does it with knowledge, he shall receive the punishment of a thief; and he who is chosen shall not be; if he does it without knowledge and is guilty, he has acted without knowledge, and let your inquiry be made that he may not die.
And Moses established for the children of Israel a statute, that they should not stray from the command of the Lord; and he ordained a statute for them, that they might turn away from all evil.

That they may dwell in righteousness and in the law, turning away from idols, from the death they have wrought and from the flesh that has been slain, for those who abide by the command of the Lord and who, as they have done, turn away from all evil deeds, he commanded them to be delivered from all that is not fitting.
That they may preserve their souls, and that they may find their dwelling with their fathers who have done good, that they may not depart from the command which is in heaven, he commanded them.
Those who believe in the word of the Lord and who walk in His command shall be called the children of the righteous. For they are those who have done the will of the Lord since Adam and the woman.
We are the children of Adam; therefore, let us do all that is good and brings joy to the Lord, and let us not be slack in our manner and in our example.
If we do good works, we shall inherit the kingdom of heaven together with those who have done good; for those who love shall not be divided.

He greatly loves those who are called pure; He hears their prayers; He accepts their offerings of repentance; and to those who keep the law and the statutes, and the commandment, He grants strength and power.
Those who do His will shall rejoice with Him forever in His kingdom; whether they be first or last, they shall offer Him praise. From this day forth and unto the ages of ages, Amen.
